title: Announcing the Python Packaging Council Election Candidates for 2026
summary: The Python Software Foundation (PSF) has announced the 17 nominees for the inaugural Python Packaging Council (PPC) election, which will fill 5 open seats. The election process includes two cohorts: Cohort A (top 2 vote-getters) with a two-year term and Cohort B (next 3 vote-getters) with a one-year term. Key dates include nomination cut-off (August 11), voter affirmation deadline (August 25), and voting period (September 1-15). Only PSF Voting Members (Supporting, Contributing, and Fellow) who affirm their intention to vote can participate. Ballots will be sent via OpaVote on September 1.
key_points: 17 nominees are running for 5 seats on the inaugural Python Packaging Council (PPC).
Top 2 vote-getters (Cohort A) will serve a two-year term; next 3 (Cohort B) will serve a one-year term.
Future elections will alternate cohorts for two-year terms to ensure staggered turnover.
Key election timeline: Nominations closed August 11, voter affirmation due August 25, voting September 1-15.
Only PSF Voting Members (Supporting, Contributing, Fellow) who affirm their voting intention can participate.
Ballots will be sent via email from OpaVote on September 1; check spam folders if missing.
